#######################################################################
# Nine-loop near-collinear (FFOPE) data for the three-point form factor
# remainder function R^(9)(u,v,w) at order T^2, produced from the finite-coupling
# form factor OPE of Sever, Tumanov and Wilhelm (arXiv:2009.11297, 2105.13367,
# 2112.10569), in the conventions and format of the ancillary file
# "T2termsyser8loops.txt" of Dixon, Gurdogan, McLeod, Wilhelm (arXiv:2204.11901).
#######################################################################
# Here is the series expansion in S through S^24,
# for the T^2 terms of the remainder function,
#
#    R^(L) = sum_{k=0}^{L-1} T^2 Log[T]^k RT2ser[L,k] + O(T^4),
#
# with   u = 1/(1+S^2+T^2),  v = T^2/(1+T^2),  w = 1/(1+T^2)/(1+(1+T^2)/S^2),
# and    y = S^2,     lny = Log[y] = 2 * Log[S].
#
# The Riemann zeta values are compressed as
# z2 = zeta[2], z3 = zeta[3], ..., z10 = zeta[10]
# (no irreducible MZV's appear).
#
# Orders in Log[T] contained in this file, at nine loops:
#   RT2ser[9,8]  (leading log, LL)
#   RT2ser[9,7]  (next-to-leading log, NLL)
#   RT2ser[9,6]  (next-to-next-to-leading log, NNLL)
# The same code reproduces every published RT2ser[L,k] with L=2..8 and
# k >= L-3 exactly through S^20.
#
############################################################
# Nine loops:
#
